results.name: FABRIC PHYSICAL PROPERTIES: Adjust Rendering Thickness
results.title: FABRIC PHYSICAL PROPERTIES: Adjust Rendering Thickness
results.body:
Objective

Set Fabric thickness for a Garment in the 3D Garment window. Rendering thickness from the center of the Garment is set for 0.5mm as the default value, and it is adjustable. This thickness value is only visible and does not Simulate as the thickness value space out between Fabrics.

※ Note: To see the rendering thickness, the 3D Garment Rendering Style must be set on Thick Textured Surface.


Location

Fabric Unit

Object Browser ▶ Fabric ▶ Fabric Item ▶Property Editor ▶ Thickness

Pattern Unit (ver2.3.0)

Select Pattern in 2D/3D Window ▶ Property Editor ▶ Simulation Properties ▶ Add'l Thickness-Rendering


Operation

Fabric Unit

  1. Follow the indicated guideline below:

    Object Browser ▶ Fabric ▶ Fabric Item ▶Property Editor ▶ Thickness

  2. Enter desired rendering thickness value.
    →The thickness is now being adjusted and applied.

Pattern Unit (ver2.3.0) 

  1. Follow the indicated guideline below:

    Select Pattern in 2D/3D Window ▶ Property Editor ▶ Simulation Properties ▶ Add'l Thickness-Rendering

  2. Enter desired rendering thickness value.
    →The thickness is now being adjusted and applied.

results.name: Add Pattern Thickness
results.title: Add Pattern Thickness
results.body:
Objective

Extrude garment to express thickness. 

(These settings will apply to mesh export when using Thick export option, or use for 3D display only). 

 

Location

2D Toolbar ▶ Edit Pattern / Transform Pattern

3D Window ▶ Garment Display Option ▶ Wireframe on Monochrome (Thick)  (ver. 2024.2)

 

Operation (ver. 2024.2)

  1. Follow the guideline below to set Garment Display Option to Wireframe on Monochrome (Thick). 

    3D Window ▶ Garment Display Option ▶ Wireframe on Monochrome (Thick)

  2. Follow the indicated guideline below:

    2D Toolbar ▶ Edit Pattern / Transform Pattern

  3. Select a Pattern or Pattern line to express doubled sided effect.

    → Its properties appear in the Property Editor.

  4. Property Editor ▶ Geometry

    → Modifies the Geometry Properties which will affect mesh style / extrusion direction when exporting with thickness.

Geometry Properties

Add'l Thickness - Rendering (mm) Displays the added thickness in addition to the Thickness value of Fabric Style.
Extrusion Direction

 Sets the direction to display the thickness.
Both Apply the thickness front/rear around the pattern.
Forward Apply the thickness in the front direction of the pattern.
Backward Apply the thickness in the rear direction of the pattern.
Toggle each side on or off to determine whether to generate the Mesh. (ver. 2025.0)
Front Face Set whether or not the front part is displayed based on the normal direction.
Back Face Set whether or not the back part is displayed based on the normal direction.
Seam Face Set whether or not to show overlapping sides on the sewn line.
Side Geometry Curvature (%) Set side geometry lateral curvature percentage. 
Resolution Set divisions for the side mesh.
Double Side Apply Curvature attribute values to both front and back symmetrical from the pattern.
UV Expansion
(ver. 2025.0) 		The Side and Back UVs can be edited in UV Editor. Video here
Back Face Check this on to show the back face UV.
Side Face Check this on to show the side thickness UV.
Mesh Style Triangle Re-mesh the pattern using triangular mesh option
Quad (Optimized) Re-mesh the pattern using quadrangular mesh option. Generates aligned automatic Retopology results. 
Quad (Grid)

Re-mesh the pattern using quadrangular mesh option.

Generates pattern with a uniform grid.
Face Count Display total face count of the pattern.
Vertex Count Display total vertex count of the pattern.

 

※ Note:

To use UV Expansion, Thick Textured surface must be active in the 3D window.

 

Operation (Ver. 2024.1 and below)

  1. Follow the indicated guideline below:

    2D Toolbar ▶ Edit Pattern / Transform Pattern

  2. Select a Pattern or Pattern line to express doubled sided effect.

    → Its properties appear in the Property Editor.

  3. Property Editor ▶ Selected Line ▶ Curved Side Geometry ▶ Check on Double Sided

    → The selected Pattern or Pattern line is now being displayed as double sided.

results.name: FABRIC PHYSICAL PROPERTIES: Adjust Collision Thickness
results.title: FABRIC PHYSICAL PROPERTIES: Adjust Collision Thickness
results.body:
Objective

Simulation thickness is invisible set property that represents the collision limit for Garments to result smooth Simulation. By default, the Simulation thickness from the Garment Pattern is set 1.5mm on each side, for a total of 3mm, and this value is adjustable as required. Lower the thickness value to work on Garments that are more likely to be form-fitting, or increase the thickness value to use as padding and etc.

※ Note: For the same reason, the default value of Avatar thickness (Skin Offset) is set for 3mm. For form-fitting Garments or accurate fitting measurement, it is recommended that Skin Offset is adjusted alongside the Simulation thickness.


Location

Select Pattern in 2D/3D Window ▶ Property Editor ▶ Simulation Properties ▶ Add'l Thickness-Collision

 

Operation

  1. Follow the indicated guideline below:

    Select Pattern in 2D/3D Window ▶ Property Editor ▶ Simulation Properties ▶ Add'l Thickness-Collision

  2. Enter desired rendering thickness value. 
    →The thickness is now being adjusted and applied.

 

※ Updated in 2026.1

Collision Thickness has been improved so that its thickness direction matches Rendering Thickness, ensuring that the visible thickness and simulation collision are applied consistently.

results.name: OBJ Sequence Export
results.title: OBJ Sequence Export
results.body:
Objective

Export an OBJ Sequence as an OBJ file on every frame of an animation.
Exporting a 1 second animation with a 30 fps standard will result in 30 OBJ files being exported.


Location

Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Export ▶ Animation ▶ OBJ Sequence


Operation

  1. Follow the indicated guideline below:
    Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Export ▶ Animation ▶ OBJ Sequence
    → The Save File window opens.

  2. Select the desired file and click OK.
    → The Export OBJ Animation window opens.

  3. Set below options as needed and click OK.

 

Export OBJ Animation Option

Object Select All Patterns: Select/Deselect all patterns. You can select specific patterns by utilizing the dropdown menu on the right (ver2.2.0).
※ When utilizing the OBJ (Selected) menu, patterns selected in the 3D and 2D windows are automatically selected and checkbox-ed.
Select All Avatars: Select/Deselect all Avatars/Objects. You can select specific objects by utilizing the dropdown menu on the right (ver2.2.0).
Select All Graphics and Trims: Select/Deselect all Graphics and Trims. You can select specific Graphics or Trims by utilizing the dropdown menu on the right (ver2.2.0).

Single Object
:Exports the selected object as a single object.

If you set the sub-object name, the name of the mesh will be the same with the sub-object name when it is saved. (ver. 5.1.4) You can set it to be saved 'Same as file name' or you can specify 'Object Name'. (ver. 5.1.4)

Multiple Objects
:Exports the selected object as multiple objects.

UnWeld

Exports the Vertex (points of the mesh) of the parts of the pattern

that are sewn together into one line into multiple objects.

※ Thickness exports for quad meshes available beginning version 2.3.0. (ver2.3.0).

Weld

Combines the Vertex (points of the mesh) of the parts of the pattern

that are sewn together into one line into one point.
Weld Selected Pattern: Weld based on the sewing line that connects the selected patterns (ver2.3.0).

Thin
Ensures that the thickness will not be exported even if the rendering thickness value is increased beforehand.

Thick

Exports a pattern with its rendering thickness values in its increased state.

Combined UV Coordinates: Exports all Garment Pattern texture data fit to UV Coordinates ranging from 0 to 1.

※Note: Unified Texture (ver3.1.0).
Export multiple layers of texture information as a single UV texture information.

Image File

Designate file saving path and file name.
Add numbers behind the file name as below:
‘File Name_0’, ‘File Name_1’.
Texture Size

Width and Height will be saved in a fixed ratio.
Allowance: 100 ~ 10000 Pixel
Fill Texture Seams

Expands the scope of the texture having its boundary line as the standard.
Allowance: 0 ~ 15 mm
When you type in values, preview will show in the 2D Window.

Include Internal Shape: Include internal line and/or shape information in export (ver2.3.0).
Scale Adjusts the scale of the file being exported when a value is entered or the desired unit from “Unit in file to import” is selected.
Axis Conversion Changes the directions of each axis of the object.
Animation

Entire Area: saves all of the recorded garment animation.
Play Area Only: saves only the play area garment animation.
Input Frame: Designate and save the frame section. (ver. 5.1.4)
You can save the Bone Information for the frame by setting Save with Bone Information (JSON).

results.name: 3D File (FBX) Import/Export
results.title: 3D File (FBX) Import/Export
results.body:
Objective

Import a file's Geometry, Material, Joint, and Camera Animation information in the FBX file format (ver2.2.0).

 

Location

Import FBX

Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Import ▶ FBX

Export FBX

Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Export ▶ FBX


Operation

Import FBX

  1. Follow the indicated guideline below:

    Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Import ▶ FBX

    → The Open File window appears.

     

  2. Select the desired file and click OK.
    → The Import FBX window appears.

     

  3. Select the settings and click OK.

    → The FBX file is imported based on the setting.

Export FBX

  1. Follow the indicated guideline below:

    Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Export ▶ FBX

    → The Save File window appears.

     

  2. Designate the file saving path and file name, and then click OK.
    → The Export OBJ window appears.

     

  3. Select the settings as needed and click OK.
    → The file is exported as a FBX file based on the setting.
     

 

※ Note:

  1. FBX SDK 2020 version is available. (ver 10)
    • Only Joint that was imported as FBX to Marvelous Designer can be exported as FBX.
  2. Import/Export FBX with multiple avatars (ver 12.2)

    • Multiple avatars can be imported or exported simultaneously using the FBX file format.

  3. Export FBX with Material Names (Ver 2025.0)
    • Material Names are now synchronized exported with the FBX.

results.name: 3D Seamline
results.title: 3D Seamline
results.body:
Objective

Adjust Intensity and Thickness of 3D seamlines to render a realistic Garment.

 

Location

Select Sewing Line ▶ Property Editor ▶ 3D Seamline

 

Operation

  1. Select the Edit Sewing tool from the 2D/3D toolbar.

  2. Follow the indicated guideline below:

    Select Sewing Line ▶ Property Editor ▶ 3D Seamline

  3. Adjust the settings below as needed:

    Option Description
    Normal Map Intensity (%) Adjust the intensity of the Normal Map applied to the seamline.
    Thickness Adjust the thickness of the Normal Map applied to the seamline.
